Market comparison technique:
The fair values are based on the market price
of livestock of similar age, weight and market
values.

Discounted cash flows: The valuation model
considers the present value of the net cash
flows expected to be generated by the
plantation. The cash flow projections include
specific estimates for periods between 10 and
20 years. The expected net cash flows are
discounted using a risk-adjusted discount rate.
